description.value: Legends Whistler is a slopeside condominium-style lodge in Whistler's quieter Creekside neighbourhood, offering one- to three-bedroom suites with full kitchens just steps from the Creekside Gondola to Whistler Blackcomb. Some suites overlook the 'Dave Murray' ski run, venue for the 2010 Winter Olympic Alpine events. The Creekside location gives touring cyclists a calmer base than the main village while remaining close to local dining and gondola access.
